sample_predictions.text: Standard baseline cycling log review conducted. All cell voltages closely balanced within 12 mV across pack. Battery cleared for continued service.
Overcurrent protection triggered on discharge line. Discharge rate surged to 37.7 A for 4 consecutive seconds. Inverter control firmware logs flagged for review.
Overvoltage alarm triggered during CC-CV charging phase. Voltage spiked to 4.37 V during top balancing, exceeding cutoff limit. Check cell balancing circuitry and wiring harness.
Overcurrent protection triggered on discharge line. Current spiked to 32.4 A during sudden regenerative braking pulse. Check current sensor calibration and shunt resistor connections.
Diagnostic check revealed questionable sensor readings. Sensor signal dropped to ground potential intermittently. Sensor replaced; bench recalibration confirmed normal operation.
Vehicle thermal management flagged abnormal heating. Busbar thermal camera inspection revealed hot spots peaking at 50.5 °C. Pack allowed to cool down to 25 °C before resuming diagnostics.
Overvoltage alarm triggered during CC-CV charging phase. Cell potential sagged to 2.25 V, below minimum safe operating limit. Inspect cell internal resistance and state of health degradation.
Technician suspected instrumentation failure on cell rig. NTC thermistor resistance reading stuck out of plausible physical range. Sensor replaced; bench recalibration confirmed normal operation.
Vehicle thermal management flagged abnormal heating. Module 2 thermistor recorded 58.0 °C, triggering critical thermal warning. Pack allowed to cool down to 25 °C before resuming diagnostics.
Technician reported excessive heat dissipation. Cell skin temp. climbed rapidly to 48.9 °C under standard discharge. Immediate thermal inspection recommended prior to next charge.
Emergency thermal inspection conducted on pack. Module 2 thermistor recorded 60.2 °C, triggering critical thermal warning. Thermal runaway mitigation procedure was initiated.
Intermittent sensor disconnect logged on CAN bus. Zero dT/dt reported while discharge current was actively flowing. Replace faulty thermistor harness and verify connector pin seating.
Post-charge quality control check carried out. Operating temperature steady at 24.2 °C throughout entire charge cycle. Next scheduled inspection in 50 operating cycles.
Intermittent sensor disconnect logged on CAN bus. Temperature reading flat-lined at -5.0 °C for 45 minutes during cycling. Check wiring insulation for crimp defects or chafing.
Intermittent sensor disconnect logged on CAN bus. Sensor signal dropped to ground potential intermittently. Sensor replaced; bench recalibration confirmed normal operation.
